next.reason: Amendment 2 (§1993:p.B-17, 'replace general rule 11b with the following') changed only 11b's wording: 'which' to 'that', and the USE procedure 'applicable to file-name-1' to the one 'associated with the file connector referenced by file-name-1'. The amended §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR11 opens 'If neither an at end nor an invalid key condition occurs during the execution of a READ statement, the AT END phrase or the INVALID KEY phrase is ignored, if specified'; a. 'The file position indicator is set and the I-O status associated with file-name-1 is updated'; b. 'control is transferred according to rules of the USE statement following the execution of any USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure associated with the file connector referenced by file-name-1'; c. the record is made available, the INTO move is executed, and control goes to the end of the READ or to imperative-statement-2. §2023:14.9.30.4 GR13 opens with the same sentence word for word and states the same steps: a) the status is updated and 'if the record operation conflict condition did not occur, the file position indicator is set'; b) 'control is transferred according to the rules in 9.1.12, Input-output exception processing. If the exception condition is not a fatal exception condition, control is then transferred to the end of the READ statement'; c) 'Control is transferred to the end of the READ statement, or, if the NOT AT END phrase or NOT INVALID KEY phrase is specified, to imperative-statement-2'. For the random READ, the second list of §2023:9.1.14 restates b and c ('the INVALID KEY phrase is ignored, if specified'; its item 1 'If the I-O status indicates an unsuccessful completion that is not an invalid key condition, control is transferred according to the rules of any applicable exception processing statements'; its item 2 'to the end of the input-output statement or to the imperative-statement specified in the NOT INVALID KEY phrase'). §2023:9.1.12 GR2 names the USE declarative as those statements, §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 executes it on the unsuccessful operation, and §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 gives the return 1985 gives in §1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR6. The conflict proviso reaches only record locking (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR9), and the WHEN phrase of 9.1.12 only an exception-checking PERFORM, neither of which 1985 can write; this rule refuses nothing, so no refusal moved. Same requirement.
